unknownPolicy: unmapped and nodata are preserved as Unknown and never counted as zero

derivation.why: Federal districts are disjoint and partition Canada, and every summed field is a count of cells, so the province total is the sum of the district counts with no approximation.

provinces.distinctTrajectoriesUnknownReason: Trajectory cardinality is not additive across districts, because two districts can exhibit the same trajectory. It cannot be derived from per-district counts and is not measured here.
